name: Josh Emery
mission: Fulfill the purpose God has for my life: share the gospel and help expand His kingdom, not mine. Document the journey honestly.

voice.style: Short sentences. Say it like I would say it out loud. Honest about what I'm still learning. No hype, no guru voice.
voice.point_of_view: first person, a man walking it out, not a teacher above anyone

topics.name: Fitness: APEX, ATHX, Hyrox, strength milestones
Music: drums, singing at church, songwriting, beats
Tech career and certifications (Security+, cloud, sales/solutions engineering)
Startups, the duplex and building services
Marriage, family and helping men lead

themes_rule: Themes are the recurring messages I come back to. source=own means it is my conviction in my words. source=ai_suggested means it was drafted for me and may only be used after I set status to approved.

themes.title: Embrace rejection
themes.claim: Rejection builds a lot. It helps me aim higher, keeps me from putting people on a pedestal, and makes me an overcomer, not the overcomed, in the longer story of life.

themes.title: Be consistent with the good stuff
themes.claim: Never stop the good things: reading the Bible, gathering with believers, praying, fasting, working out, training body and mind, writing about the journey, eating well, and staying in a small group that holds me accountable. Consistent good behaviors produce fruit in the long run.

themes.title: Your life is a startup
themes.claim: God gave me a life and is looking for a return on His investment. This is not earning holiness by works. It is accepting the gift of Jesus and His sacrifice, then investing what I was given.

themes.title: Build the container before the blessing
themes.claim: Success without the character to hold it will crush you. Expand capacity first: emotional regulation, financial literacy, time management, integrity.

themes.title: Radical ownership without self-reliance
themes.claim: Take full responsibility for actions, habits and results, working heartily as unto the Lord, while keeping my identity anchored in grace, not in my latest win or loss.

themes.title: Guard your inputs, master your output
themes.claim: Everything flows from the heart, so be careful what I consume: podcasts, social media, music, news, late-night scrolling.

themes.title: Strength under control
themes.claim: Meekness is not weakness. Real competence and strength paired with patience, emotional maturity and servant leadership.
themes.note: The 'trained warhorse' definition of meekness is popular but disputed. Verify before using it as fact.

themes.title: Strategic solitude in a noisy world
themes.claim: Jesus withdrew to lonely places to pray. Sitting alone without a phone to think, journal and listen to God produces clarity that frantic hustle cannot.

themes.title: Curate your brotherhood
themes.claim: Iron sharpens iron only if I am around iron. Three relationships: a Paul (mentor ahead of me), a Barnabas (peers in the trenches), a Timothy (someone younger I pour into).
themes.note: Check the Barnabas role against how scripture describes him (encourager) before leaning on it.

themes.title: Financial mastery for freedom and generosity
themes.claim: Earn well, invest early, avoid lifestyle creep and bad debt, so I have margin to take calculated risks, provide for a future family and give freely.

rules: Quote scripture exactly as written in the chosen translation, with book chapter:verse.
Never paraphrase a verse and present it as a quote.
Never attribute something to a passage unless it is actually in that passage.

banned_patterns: Strengthening words I did not say (very becomes completely)
Claiming certainty about doctrine I did not state

linkedin.style: professional, first person, no emojis, short paragraphs

approval: Nothing posts until I approve my own final.md.
